RFC5282-3-1.note: Forbidden: a receiver refusing a message for its Padding length (0..255). Red: TestRFC5282AEADReceiveAcceptsAnyPaddingTo255 fatals 'decryptAndParse = %v, want the message accepted' for every length 0..255. Negative TestRFC5282AEADReceiveRefusesATruncatedInnerPayload bounds it (expectRefused).

RFC5282-3.1-1.note: Forbidden: an IV other than eight octets. Sender: TestRFC5282AEADSendIVIsEightOctets opens ze's LastSentMsg with the first 8 octets as IV and asserts gotIVOctets == 8. Receiver: TestRFC5282AEADReceiveRefusesAnIVThatIsNotEightOctets expectRefused for 7 and 9. The IV length is the shared ikeIVOctets for GCM and CCM.

RFC5282-3.1-2.note: Forbidden: an IV repeated under one key. Red: TestRFC5282AEADSendIVIsUniquePerKey fatals on any repeat over 512 builds under one SA; TestRFC5282AEADSendIVDoesNotRepeatForARepeatedMessage fatals when two byte-identical builds share an IV.

RFC5282-3.2-1.note: Forbidden: not supporting the 16 octet AES GCM ICV. Red: TestRFC5282AEADSendICVIsSixteenOctets asserts len(raw)==prefix+IV+plaintext+16 and expectOneDelete on the receiver; TestRFC5282AEADReceiveRefusesADamagedICV proves the 16 octets are verified (flipped and stripped ICV refused).

RFC5282-3.2-2.note: Forbidden: supporting an AES GCM ICV other than 16, 8, 12. Red: TestRFC5282AEADRefusesAForbiddenICVLength fatals if OpenIKEAEAD(ENCR_AES_GCM_16) accepts a real 13, 14 or 15 octet ICV sealing; TestRFC5282AEADOpensTheFullLengthICV keeps 16 open. Lengths below 12 are not constructed (stdlib limit); ze's only GCM transform (20) fixes the tag at 16, so no other length is reachable.

RFC5282-3.2-3.note: Forbidden: not supporting AES CCM ICVs of 8 and 16. Red: TestRFC5282CCMSupportsTheEightAndSixteenOctetICV establishes under CCM8 and CCM16, measures the ICV (t.Errorf on mismatch) and expectOneDelete; TestRFC5282CCMVerifiesTheEightAndSixteenOctetICV refuses a flipped ICV bit and a flipped ciphertext bit at each size.

RFC5282-3.2-4.note: Forbidden: an AES CCM ICV length other than 8, 16, 12. Red: TestRFC5282CCMRefusesEveryOtherICVLength sweeps Transform IDs 0..35, errors if AEADICVOctets answers a length outside {8,12,16} or answers for any id beyond 14,15,16,20, and requires SealIKEAEAD/OpenIKEAEAD to refuse the rest; TestRFC5282CCMSupportsTheThreePermittedICVLengths seals and opens 8, 12 and 16.

RFC5282-4-1.note: Clause 'both the encryptor and decryptor construct the nonce by concatenating the salt with the IV' for AES GCM. Decryptor: TestRFC5282AEADNonceIsSaltThenIV accepts salt||IV, TestRFC5282AEADRefusesAReversedNonce refuses IV||salt. Encryptor: no 4-1 tagged unit checks the nonce ze seals under; SealIKEAEAD calling ikeAEADNonce with its arguments swapped keeps the same length and turns no 4-1 unit red. TestRFC5282AEADSendIVIsEightOctets opens ze's own message under salt||IV but is tagged 3.1-1 only.

RFC5282-4-2.note: Forbidden: an AES GCM nonce other than 12 octets. Red: TestRFC5282AEADNonceIsTwelveOctets asserts len(nonce)==12 and expectOneDelete; TestRFC5282AEADRefusesANonceThatIsNotTwelveOctets refuses 11 and 13. Sender side: the nonce size is fixed once in newIKEAEAD (salt+ikeIVOctets, checked by newAESGCM) and shared by SealIKEAEAD and OpenIKEAEAD, and Go's AEAD panics on a wrong-length nonce, so a sender-only length change is not reachable without reddening the receive units.

RFC5282-4-3.note: Forbidden: an AES CCM nonce not built as salt||IV. Encryptor: TestRFC5282CCMNonceIsSaltThenIV opens ze's own sent message with an independent CCM under the 3 salt octets then the wire IV (fatal on failure). Decryptor: TestRFC5282CCMRefusesAReversedNonce refuses IV||salt.

RFC5282-4-4.note: Forbidden: an AES CCM nonce other than 11 octets. Red: TestRFC5282CCMNonceIsElevenOctets asserts len(nonce)==11 and expectOneDelete; TestRFC5282CCMRefusesANonceThatIsNotElevenOctets refuses 10 and 12. Sender length is fixed by the shared newIKEAEAD (ccm.New with salt+IV), so a sender-only change is not reachable without reddening these.

RFC5282-5.1-1.note: The associated data MUST span the fixed header through the SK generic header, including intervening payloads. Receiver: TestRFC5282AEADAssociatedDataCoversAnInterveningPayload accepts a test-sealed message over that span, TestRFC5282AEADRefusesAnAlteredInterveningPayload refuses an altered Notify. Sender: the AAD ze seals under is cut in buildSKMessageAEADWithMsgID, a separate producer, and no 5.1-1 tagged unit checks it; a sender cutting the AAD at 32 octets or past the SK header turns no 5.1-1 unit red.

RFC5282-5.1-2.note: The IV and Ciphertext MUST NOT be in the associated data. Receiver: TestRFC5282AEADAssociatedDataExcludesTheIVAndCiphertext accepts a span ending at the SK header, TestRFC5282AEADRefusesAssociatedDataCoveringTheIV refuses one covering the IV. Sender: no 5.1-2 tagged unit checks the AAD buildSKMessageAEADWithMsgID seals under; TestRFC5282AEADSendIVIsEightOctets opens ze's message under raw[:DataOffset] but is tagged 3.1-1 only.

RFC5282-7.1-1.note: Clause 'When AES GCM or AES CCM is used ... each key MUST be treated as having a size of zero'. AES GCM: TestRFC5282AEADIntegrityKeysAreZeroOctets asserts zero-length SK_ai/SK_ar and the SK_ei offset; TestRFC5282NonAEADIntegrityKeysAreDerived is the negative. AES CCM: no tagged unit derives a CCM key hierarchy, so a CCM derivation reserving integrity key material turns nothing red.

RFC5282-7.1-2.note: Both bullets are obligations. AES GCM: TestRFC5282AEADEncryptionKeysCarryTheirSalt asserts 20/36 octets and a key-then-salt round trip; TestRFC5282NonAEADEncryptionKeysCarryNoSalt is the negative. AES CCM bullet (19 octets at 128 bits, key then 3 octets of salt): no 7.1-2 tagged unit asserts it; encKeyMaterialLen's CCM branch could size the key wrong with no 7.1-2 unit red.

RFC5282-7.3-1.note: Clause 'any of the identifiers for AES GCM or AES CCM'. AES GCM: TestRFC5282AEADProposalCarriesTheKeyLengthAttribute asserts exactly one Key Length attribute on the IKE and ESP rails; TestRFC5282AEADOfferWithoutAKeyLengthIsRefused refuses a missing attribute. AES CCM (identifiers 14, 15, 16, offered on the IKE rail): no tagged unit asserts ze sends the attribute; assertKeyLength even fatals on any Transform ID other than 20.

RFC5282-8-1.note: Clause 'for any SA (IKE or ESP)'. IKE SA: TestRFC5282AEADSelectionCarriesNoIntegrityAlgorithm asserts AUTH_NONE, zero key length and zero SK_ai/SK_ar; TestRFC5282AEADOfferWithIntegrityIsRefused refuses a peer's integrity transform beside AES GCM. ESP SA: no tagged unit asserts that ESP negotiation with an AEAD cipher selects no integrity algorithm.

RFC5282-8-2.note: Clause 'any proposal'. IKE proposal: TestRFC5282AEADIKEProposalCarriesNoIntegrityTransform asserts zero Transform Type 3 from buildWireIKEProposals; TestRFC5282NonAEADIKEProposalKeepsItsIntegrityTransform is the negative. ESP proposal: espProposalToWire's omission for an AEAD ESP proposal is not asserted by any 8-2 tagged unit.
